## Related Tickets & Documents
#1606 

## Added to documentation?
- [x] no documentation needed

body:
I've started work on this one.
When loading comments with one request it's harder query a limited amout of root comments + their ancestors. So I was concerned with the memory usage while arranging the whole tree (+ regarding the `includes(:user)`).
I've checked the memory usage by `memory-profiler` and it seems like there's no dramatic change comparing with the old version. With limited comments (on the article show page) the usage is even less.
However, I'll explore the options to refactor so that only the limited comments are loaded and see if there are any benefits.
I also plan to refactor the code which loads comments and displays the tree.
